purpose: Explicit recursive request receipt composition, immutable preprocessing provenance and strict GPU completion across typed/untyped request boundaries
result: passed bounded request-composition and recursive-empty proof checks; 24 GPU-required recursive requests and 12 independent GPU-required registered proofs were CPU-verified after shutdown
api_change: Reports include named component completions; IncompleteCoverage identifies missing components. Typed/untyped request boundaries explicitly compose scoped child runs and immutable cached preprocessing provenance, enforcing all 16 arithmetic stages before returning strict output.
limitations: End-to-end native request qualification covers bounded empty recursion in three/five/six/twelve-key registries, wide/narrow release and full/compact storage. Wrap, pair, merge and finalizer paths use the same explicit composition but their full-size end-to-end GPU-required proof workloads remain unqualified.

CPU parsing, static metadata, input/result verification, serialization and host application remain outside the proving arithmetic contract. Request elapsed time includes host orchestration and verification.
Root receipt totals aggregate child totals; telemetry consumers must select a scope rather than sum root and child reports. Cached components contribute provenance only.
Debug recursive/registered proving retains explicitly declared CPU constraint audits and rejects GPU-required admission before private work.
Legacy wallet and batch proving, owned multi-AIR commitment, production-size resources and sustained multi-worker throughput remain unfinished.
Qualification covers bounded NVIDIA OpenCL on one laptop GPU. AMD/Metal and pending Apple source integration remain open; no SSH attempted.
